text: Entry Requirements Bachelor's degree certificate,non-Chinese. Students with HSK 5(180 or more)and HSKK intermediate(50 or more)can apply for MTCSOL. Other major requires to pass HSK6(180 or more). Note: The cost of one academic year (postgraduate) is 25500 yuan. The fee includes registration fee, tuition fee and miscellaneous fee, which shall be paid at one time upon enrollment.
